## OPERATOR DECISION 2026-08-05: DECLARE and ENFORCE Git 2.38+

The operator ruled: document and enforce a Git 2.38+ floor, rather than add a runtime
capability guard that skips the test on older clients.

Rationale, and it is worth recording because it generalizes: a skip guard means the two-clone
enrichment regression (added for bug 8185) silently does not run for some contributors. That
is precisely how a guard goes VACUOUS -- the same rot class as 34c2 (the DC pagination guard
that scanned only transport.py and was emptied by a module split) and its sibling
8a5e-b88e-0c3e-4544 (four more single-file AST guards found vacuous). A test that quietly
does not run is worse than no test, because it reads as coverage.

Scope: determine and document the supported Git floor for contributors and CI, enforce it
with a clear failure message naming the required version, and verify the 8185 regression
remains collected and executed on every gating CI environment.
